sections.content: I am writing on behalf of my [CHARACTER_RELATIONSHIP], [CLIENT_FULL_NAME], in connection with [CHARACTER_MATTER]. I am [A_LICENSE_TYPE] licensed in [LICENSE_STATE_PHRASE] (license no. [LICENSE_NUMBER]), and [CHARACTER_TREATMENT_DATES].
In my work with [CLIENT_FIRST_NAME], I have seen these qualities:

As a mental health professional, I respectfully ask the Court to consider alternatives to incarceration, such as [CHARACTER_ALTERNATIVES]. In my experience, guided support has helped [CLIENT_FIRST_NAME] make meaningful progress.
[CLIENT_FIRST_NAME] has signed a release of information allowing me to share this letter with the Court.
Thank you for your time and consideration of [CLIENT_FIRST_NAME]’s circumstances.
